title: Chicken Kabsa
steps: Brown the chicken in ghee, remove, then fry the onions until golden.
Add tomatoes, tomato paste, spices, dried limes and chicken with 4 cups of water. Simmer 30 minutes.
Add the rinsed rice to the stock, cover and cook on low for 20 minutes. Top with raisins and almonds.

title: Chicken Mandi
steps: Rub the chicken with oil, spices and salt and roast at 200°C for about 45 minutes until cooked.
Cook the rice with onion, dried limes and a little spice in stock until fluffy.
Serve the chicken over the rice.

title: Lamb Mansaf
steps: Simmer the lamb with onion until very tender, about 1.5 hours.
Warm the yogurt gently with a little lamb broth, stirring constantly in one direction so it does not split.
Cook the rice. Layer bread, rice and lamb on a platter, pour over the yogurt sauce and top with nuts.

title: Chicken Shawarma

ingredients.name: Garlic sauce, pickles, tomato and cucumber

steps: Marinate the chicken in yogurt, spice, lemon, garlic and oil for at least 2 hours.
Roast or pan-fry until charred and cooked through, then slice thinly.
Wrap in warm pita with garlic sauce, pickles and vegetables.

title: Hummus
steps: Blend tahini and lemon juice for a minute until pale. Add garlic, chickpeas, cumin, salt and ice water and blend until very smooth.
Serve drizzled with olive oil and paprika.

title: Falafel
steps: Blend everything except the baking powder to a coarse paste. Rest 30 minutes, then stir in the baking powder.
Shape into balls and fry in hot oil until deep golden and crisp.
Serve in pita with tahini sauce, tomatoes and pickles.

title: Tabbouleh
steps: Soak the bulgur in lemon juice for 15 minutes. Mix with parsley, tomatoes, mint and green onions.
Dress with olive oil and salt.

title: Fattoush
steps: Chop the vegetables and herbs, break in the crisp pita.
Whisk olive oil, lemon, sumac and salt, dress just before serving.

title: Mutabbal (Baba Ghanoush)
steps: Char the eggplants over a flame or in a very hot oven until collapsed. Scoop out the flesh.
Mash with tahini, lemon, garlic and salt. Serve drizzled with olive oil.

title: Shakshuka
steps: Soften onion and pepper in olive oil, add garlic and spices, then the tomatoes. Simmer 10 minutes.
Make wells in the sauce and crack in the eggs. Cover and cook until the whites are set.
Scatter with parsley and serve with bread.

title: Lentil Soup
steps: Sauté onion, carrots and garlic in oil with cumin. Add lentils and broth and simmer until soft, 25 minutes.
Blend until smooth and finish with lemon juice.

title: Chicken Musakhan
steps: Roast the chicken with salt and allspice until cooked.
Cook the onions slowly in olive oil with sumac until deeply soft and sweet.
Pile the onions and chicken over the bread, scatter with pine nuts and bake 10 minutes.

title: Stuffed Grape Leaves
steps: Mix rice, onions, tomatoes, herbs, oil and salt. Roll a spoonful in each leaf.
Pack tightly in a pot, add water, oil and lemon juice, weigh down with a plate and simmer 45 minutes.

title: Greek Salad
steps: Toss the vegetables and olives. Top with feta, oil and oregano.

title: Lemon Herb Roast Chicken
steps: Rub the chicken with oil, salt, herbs and lemon zest; stuff with lemon halves and garlic.
Roast at 200°C with the potatoes around it for about 70 minutes until the juices run clear.

title: Chicken Souvlaki
steps: Marinate the chicken in oil, lemon, garlic and oregano for 1 hour.
Thread onto skewers and grill 10 minutes, turning. Serve in pita with tzatziki.

title: Tzatziki
steps: Mix everything and chill 30 minutes.

title: Turkish Menemen
steps: Cook onion and peppers in butter until soft, add tomatoes and cook until jammy.
Pour in the beaten eggs and stir gently until just set. Serve with bread.

title: Adana Kebab

ingredients.name: Flatbread and sumac onions, to serve

steps: Knead everything for 5 minutes until sticky, rest 30 minutes.
Mould along flat skewers and grill, turning, until cooked and charred.

title: Red Lentil Kofte
steps: Cook the lentils in water until soft, stir in the bulgur, cover and rest 15 minutes.
Fry the onion in oil with tomato paste, mix into the lentils with the green onions, cumin, parsley and salt.
Shape into small ovals and serve in lettuce leaves with lemon.

title: Persian Chelo Kabab
steps: Knead the meat with onion, turmeric and salt until sticky; rest 1 hour.
Press onto flat skewers and grill until browned.
Boil the rice until nearly done, drain and steam with butter. Serve with grilled tomatoes and sumac.

title: Persian Tahdig Rice
steps: Par-boil the rice in salted water for 6 minutes and drain.
Mix a cup of rice with yogurt, saffron and oil and spread over the bottom of a non-stick pot.
Pile on the remaining rice, poke steam holes, wrap the lid in a towel and cook on low 40 minutes until a golden crust forms.

title: Moroccan Chicken Tagine
steps: Brown the chicken in oil, add onions, garlic and spices and cook until fragrant.
Add 1 cup of water, cover and simmer for 40 minutes. Add olives and lemon for the last 10 minutes.
Serve with couscous or bread.

title: Harira Soup
steps: Simmer the meat, onion, celery, spices, tomatoes and lentils in 8 cups water for 40 minutes.
Add chickpeas and vermicelli and cook 10 minutes. Finish with herbs and lemon.

title: Couscous with Vegetables
steps: Sauté onion in oil with spices, add the chopped vegetables, tomatoes and 3 cups water and simmer 25 minutes, adding chickpeas at the end.
Steam the couscous with hot water and a little oil, fluff and serve with the vegetables.

title: Egyptian Koshari
steps: Cook the lentils, rice and macaroni separately and combine.
Simmer the tomato sauce with garlic, cumin and vinegar.
Layer the grains, top with chickpeas, sauce and crisp fried onions.

title: Ful Medames
steps: Warm the beans with their liquid and mash lightly.
Stir in garlic, lemon, cumin and salt. Top with olive oil, chopped tomato and parsley.

title: Naan
steps: Mix everything into a soft dough, knead 8 minutes and rise 1 hour.
Divide, roll into ovals and cook on a very hot dry pan or cast iron until puffed and charred. Brush with ghee.

title: Roti (Chapati)
steps: Knead the flour, water and salt into a soft dough and rest 20 minutes.
Roll thin rounds and cook on a hot tawa until it puffs, flipping once.

title: Pita Bread
steps: Knead into a smooth dough and rise 1 hour.
Roll into rounds and bake at 250°C on a preheated tray for 4 to 5 minutes until puffed.

title: Simple Sandwich Bread
steps: Knead all together until smooth, rise 1 hour, shape into a loaf in a greased pan.
Rise 45 minutes more and bake at 180°C for 35 minutes.

title: Banana Bread
steps: Mash the bananas and mix with sugar, butter and egg. Fold in the dry ingredients.
Bake in a loaf pan at 175°C for 55 to 60 minutes.

title: Garlic Naan Butter Flatbread
steps: Mix flour, yogurt, baking powder and salt into a dough, rest 15 minutes.
Roll thick rounds, cook in a hot pan until golden and brush with garlic butter.

title: Cinnamon Rolls
steps: Make a soft dough from the flour, yeast, milk, sugar, butter and egg, knead and rise 1 hour.
Roll into a rectangle, spread with butter, brown sugar and cinnamon, roll up and cut into 12.
Rise 30 minutes, bake at 180°C for 25 minutes, and top with cream cheese icing.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Cream the butter and sugars, beat in the eggs and vanilla, then stir in the flour mixture and chocolate chips.
Scoop onto trays and bake at 180°C for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Brownies
steps: Whisk butter, sugar, eggs and vanilla. Stir in cocoa and flour, then chocolate chips.
Bake in a lined 8-inch pan at 175°C for 25 minutes.

title: Baklava
steps: Layer the phyllo in a pan, brushing each sheet with butter, scattering nuts between layers. Cut into diamonds.
Bake at 175°C for 45 minutes. Boil the sugar, water, honey and lemon for 10 minutes and pour over the hot baklava.

title: Kunafa
steps: Mix the shredded pastry with butter. Press half into a pan, add the cheese, top with the rest.
Bake at 200°C for 35 minutes until golden. Boil the sugar, water and rose water for 8 minutes and pour over. Top with pistachios.

title: Basbousa
steps: Mix the dry ingredients with yogurt and butter. Spread in a pan, cut into diamonds and bake at 180°C for 30 minutes.
Boil the syrup ingredients for 8 minutes and pour over the hot cake.

title: Rice Pudding
steps: Simmer the rice in the milk, stirring often, until thick and creamy, 35 minutes. Stir in the sugar and vanilla and sprinkle with cinnamon.

title: Umm Ali
steps: Bake the pastry until crisp, break into a dish and scatter with nuts and raisins.
Heat the milk and sugar, pour over, top with cream and bake at 200°C until bubbling and golden.

title: Dates and Walnut Energy Balls
steps: Blend everything until it sticks together, roll into balls and coat in coconut.

title: Fruit Chaat
steps: Chop the fruit, toss with lemon, sugar and chaat masala, and chill.

title: Chicken Pakora
steps: Mix the flour, spices and salt with water to a thick batter. Fold in the onions and spinach.
Drop spoonfuls into hot oil and fry until golden and crisp.

title: Vegetable Pakora
steps: Whisk the flour, spices and salt with water to a thick batter, dip the vegetables and fry until crisp.

title: Fresh Mint Lemonade
steps: Blend the lemon juice, sugar, mint and a cup of water, strain, add the rest of the water and serve over ice.

title: Karak Chai
steps: Boil the water, tea and cardamom for 4 minutes, add the milk and sugar and simmer until strong and creamy.

title: Rooh Afza Milk
steps: Stir the syrup into the cold milk and serve over ice.

title: Strawberry Smoothie
steps: Blend until smooth.

title: Chicken Karahi

ingredients.name: Fresh coriander and ginger, to garnish

steps: Heat the oil in a wok, add the cumin seeds and ginger-garlic paste and fry for a minute.
Add the chicken and sear on high heat until it changes colour, about 8 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, green chilies, salt, coriander and chili powder. Cover and cook on medium until the oil separates and the chicken is tender, 25 minutes.
Finish with garam masala, ginger and fresh coriander.

title: Chicken Biryani

ingredients.name: Whole spices (cardamom, cloves, cinnamon, bay leaf)

steps: Soak the rice 30 minutes. Fry the onions in oil until deep golden; set half aside for layering.
Add ginger-garlic paste, tomatoes, spices, yogurt and chicken to the pot. Cook until the chicken is tender and the masala is thick.
Boil the rice in salted water with whole spices until 70% cooked, then drain.
Layer rice over the chicken, top with fried onions, mint and chilies. Cover tightly and steam on low for 20 minutes.

title: Chicken Qorma
steps: Fry the onions in ghee until golden, then add ginger-garlic paste and chicken and brown for 8 minutes.
Stir in the yogurt, qorma masala and salt. Cover and simmer until the chicken is tender, about 35 minutes.
Stir in the ground almonds and garam masala and cook until the gravy is thick and glossy.

title: Beef Nihari

ingredients.name: Fresh ginger strips, green chilies and lemon, to serve

steps: Brown the sliced onions in ghee, add the meat and ginger-garlic paste and fry for 10 minutes.
Add nihari masala, salt and 6 cups of water. Cover and simmer on low for 2.5 hours until the meat is falling apart.
Mix the flour with a little cold water, stir it into the pot and cook 10 minutes more until thick.
Serve hot with ginger, green chilies, lemon and naan.

title: Beef Qeema
steps: Fry the onions in oil until golden. Add the ginger-garlic paste and the qeema and cook until the water dries up.
Add the tomatoes, spices and salt and cook until the oil separates.
Add the peas and a splash of water, cover and simmer 10 minutes. Garnish with fresh coriander.

title: Aloo Gosht
steps: Fry the onions in oil until golden, add ginger-garlic paste and the meat and brown well.
Add tomatoes, spices and salt with 1 cup water. Cover and cook on low until the meat is nearly tender, about 45 minutes.
Add the potatoes and 1 more cup of water, cook until soft. Finish with garam masala.

title: Haleem

ingredients.name: Lemon, ginger, mint and fried onions, to serve

steps: Soak the lentils, barley and cracked wheat for 4 hours.
Cook the meat with ginger-garlic paste, spices, salt and plenty of water until very tender, then shred.
Add the soaked grains and cook until soft and creamy, mashing and stirring often, 1.5 to 2 hours.
Fry the onions in ghee until crisp. Serve topped with fried onions, lemon, ginger and mint.

title: Chana Masala
steps: Fry the cumin seeds and onions in oil until golden. Add ginger-garlic paste and cook a minute.
Add the tomato puree, turmeric, chana masala and salt, cooking until the oil separates.
Add the chickpeas and 1/2 cup water, simmer 15 minutes, mashing a few chickpeas to thicken.
Finish with lemon juice and fresh coriander.

title: Butter Chicken
steps: Marinate the chicken in yogurt, half the ginger-garlic paste, chili and salt for at least 30 minutes, then pan-fry or broil until browned.
Melt the butter, cook the onion until soft, add remaining paste, tomatoes and garam masala and simmer 15 minutes. Blend smooth if you like.
Add the chicken and cream and simmer 10 minutes. Crush in the fenugreek leaves and serve.

title: Palak Paneer
steps: Blanch the spinach for 2 minutes, drain and blend to a puree.
Fry the cumin and onion in ghee, add ginger-garlic paste and tomatoes and cook down.
Add the spinach puree, garam masala and salt and simmer 5 minutes. Stir in the paneer and cream and warm through.

title: Dal Tadka
steps: Boil the lentils with turmeric, tomato, salt and 3 cups water until completely soft, about 25 minutes.
Heat the ghee, fry the cumin, garlic, chilies and onion until golden.
Pour the tadka over the dal, stir and finish with coriander and lemon.

title: Vegetable Biryani
steps: Fry the onions in ghee until golden. Add the vegetables, yogurt, masala and salt and cook 10 minutes.
Par-boil the rice in salted water, drain, and layer over the vegetables with mint and fried onions.
Cover tightly and steam on low for 20 minutes.

title: Aloo Gobi
steps: Fry cumin and onion in oil, add tomatoes and spices and cook until soft.
Add potatoes and cauliflower with a splash of water, cover and cook on low until tender, 20 minutes.
Uncover and cook off the liquid, finishing with garam masala.

title: Tandoori-Style Chicken
steps: Score the chicken, then marinate in everything else for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Roast at 220°C (425°F) for 35 to 40 minutes, turning once, until charred at the edges and cooked through.
Serve with lemon, onion rings and mint chutney.

title: Samosa
steps: Knead flour, 4 tbsp oil, salt and water into a firm dough. Rest 30 minutes.
Cook cumin, peas and spices briefly in a little oil, then mix with the mashed potatoes.
Roll the dough into ovals, cut in half, shape into cones, fill, and seal the edges with water.
Fry on medium-low heat until golden and crisp.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
steps: Marinate the chicken in yogurt, half the spice blend and salt for 1 hour, then broil or pan-fry until charred.
Soften the onion in butter, add ginger-garlic paste, remaining spices and tomato sauce, simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in the cream and chicken and simmer 10 minutes.

title: Masoor Dal Soup
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in oil with cumin and turmeric.
Add lentils and 4 cups water, simmer 20 minutes until soft, blend if you like, season and add lemon juice.

title: Paratha
steps: Mix flour, salt and water into a soft dough, knead 5 minutes and rest 20 minutes.
Roll each ball thin, brush with ghee, fold into a triangle or spiral, then roll out again.
Cook on a hot griddle, brushing with ghee, until golden and flaky on both sides.

title: Aloo Paratha
steps: Knead flour, salt and water into a soft dough; rest 20 minutes.
Mix potatoes with spices, chilies and salt.
Stuff each dough ball with potato filling, seal and roll out gently.
Cook on a hot griddle with ghee until golden and speckled.

title: Chicken Pulao

ingredients.name: Whole spices (cardamom, cloves, cinnamon, bay leaf)

steps: Fry the onions in oil until deep brown, add the chicken, ginger-garlic paste, cumin and whole spices and cook for 10 minutes.
Add 4 cups of water and salt, boil until the chicken is tender, then strain out some of the stock if too much.
Add the soaked rice, cook until the water is absorbed, then cover and steam on low for 15 minutes.

title: Seekh Kebab
steps: Mix everything very well until sticky. Rest 30 minutes.
Shape onto skewers or into logs.
Grill or broil, turning, until browned and cooked through, about 12 minutes. Serve with naan and raita.

title: Raita
steps: Whisk the yogurt until smooth and stir in the cucumber, cumin, chili, mint and salt. Chill and serve.

title: Mango Lassi
steps: Blend everything until smooth and serve cold.

title: Kheer
steps: Rinse the rice and simmer in the milk with cardamom, stirring often, until very soft and creamy, about 45 minutes.
Stir in the sugar, nuts and raisins and cook 5 minutes more. Serve warm or chilled.

title: Gulab Jamun
steps: Boil sugar, water and cardamom for 5 minutes to make a light syrup.
Mix milk powder, flour, baking powder and ghee, adding milk to make a soft dough. Shape into smooth small balls.
Fry on low heat until deep golden brown, then soak in warm syrup for at least 1 hour.

title: Zarda
steps: Boil the rice with the colour and cardamom until 80% done and drain.
Heat ghee, add sugar, nuts and a splash of water to make a thick syrup.
Layer the rice with the syrup, cover tightly and steam on low for 15 minutes.

title: Chai
steps: Boil the water with cardamom and tea for 3 minutes.
Add the milk and sugar and simmer until rich in colour. Strain and serve.

title: Fluffy Pancakes
steps: Whisk the dry ingredients, then stir in milk, egg and butter until just combined.
Cook 1/4 cup scoops on a buttered griddle until bubbles form, flip and cook until golden.

title: French Toast
steps: Whisk eggs, milk, cinnamon and vanilla. Soak the bread slices briefly.
Fry in butter until golden on both sides. Serve with syrup or fruit.

title: Masala Omelette
steps: Beat the eggs with everything except the oil. Pour into a hot oiled pan, cook until set, fold and serve with toast or paratha.

title: Overnight Oats
steps: Stir the oats, milk, yogurt and honey together in a jar. Refrigerate overnight and top with berries.

title: Breakfast Burrito
steps: Scramble the eggs with the diced pepper. Warm the beans.
Fill each tortilla with eggs, beans, cheese and salsa, roll and toast seam-side down.

title: Chicken Alfredo
steps: Cook the pasta. Pan-sear the chicken in butter until golden and cooked through; set aside.
Simmer the garlic and cream for 5 minutes, stir in the Parmesan until smooth, then toss with pasta and chicken.

title: Beef Lasagna
steps: Brown the beef with onion and garlic, add the sauce and simmer 15 minutes. Mix the ricotta with the egg.
Layer noodles, meat sauce, ricotta and mozzarella three times, ending with cheese.
Bake covered at 190°C for 40 minutes, uncover and bake 15 minutes more.

title: Beef Tacos
steps: Brown the beef and onion, stir in the taco seasoning with a splash of water and simmer 5 minutes.
Fill the shells and top as you like.

title: Chicken Fajitas
steps: Toss the chicken with seasoning and sear in hot oil. Add peppers and onion and cook until charred.
Serve in warm tortillas with sour cream and salsa.

title: Chicken Noodle Soup
steps: Simmer the chicken, vegetables and broth for 25 minutes. Shred the chicken.
Cook the noodles in the soup until tender and return the chicken. Season and add parsley.

title: Beef and Broccoli Stir-Fry
steps: Toss the beef with cornstarch. Mix the soy sauce, sugar, garlic, ginger and 1/2 cup water.
Sear the beef in hot oil, add broccoli and sauce and cook until thickened and glossy. Serve over rice.

title: Beef Burgers
steps: Mix the beef with egg, breadcrumbs, salt and pepper and shape into 4 patties.
Grill or pan-fry 5 minutes per side. Assemble on toasted buns.

title: Spaghetti Bolognese
steps: Brown the beef with the onion, carrot and garlic. Add the tomatoes, tomato paste and oregano and simmer 30 minutes.
Serve over the cooked spaghetti.

title: Creamy Mushroom Chicken
steps: Sear the chicken in butter and set aside. Cook the mushrooms and garlic in the same pan.
Add broth and cream, reduce slightly, return the chicken and simmer until cooked through.

title: Baked Salmon with Lemon
steps: Place the fillets on a tray, brush with oil, garlic, lemon slices, dill and seasoning.
Bake at 200°C for 12 to 15 minutes until it flakes easily.

title: Vegetable Stir-Fry Noodles
steps: Cook the noodles. Stir-fry the garlic and vegetables in hot oil.
Add the noodles, soy sauce and sesame oil and toss until hot.

title: Egg Fried Rice
steps: Scramble the eggs in hot oil and push aside. Add the vegetables and rice and fry on high heat.
Season with soy sauce and finish with green onions.

title: Tomato Basil Soup
steps: Soften onion and garlic in butter, add tomatoes and broth and simmer 20 minutes.
Blend smooth, stir in cream and basil.

title: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
steps: Butter the bread, fill with cheese and toast in a pan until golden and melted.

title: Chicken Caesar Wrap
steps: Toss the chicken, lettuce, cheese and dressing, wrap in the tortillas and serve.

title: Macaroni and Cheese
steps: Cook the macaroni. Make a roux with butter and flour, whisk in milk and cook until thick.
Melt in the cheese and fold through the pasta.
